coords: normalised 0-1, origin top-left of the frame
note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: Pump Head LCD
parts.description: A round screen on the pump cap that can show live readouts such as CPU temperature, framed by an ARGB light ring.

parts.name: Pump Block and Cold Plate
parts.description: The pump that circulates the coolant, sitting on a copper cold plate that touches the CPU and draws its heat into the liquid.

parts.name: Mounting Bracket
parts.description: The cross-shaped bracket and thumb screws that hold the pump block down firmly onto the CPU socket.

parts.name: Coolant Tubes
parts.description: Two flexible, braided-sleeve hoses that carry warm coolant to the radiator and cooled coolant back to the pump.

parts.name: Fittings
parts.description: Swivel connectors where the tubes join the radiator and the pump block, sealed so the loop never needs refilling.

parts.name: ARGB Fans (x3)
parts.description: Three 120 mm fans with addressable pink and cyan lighting that push air through the radiator fins.

parts.name: Radiator (360mm)
parts.description: A 360 mm long finned heat exchanger. Coolant flows through thin channels while the fans blow the heat away.
